name: cinematic-service-brand-reveal
description: A premium cinematic three-act arc for local/regional service businesses on Instagram Reels and TikTok (9:16, 28-33s). Opens with an aspirational slow-reveal hook — a calm declarative naming the viewer's latent desire ("Your space deserves to be transformed"). Pivots to a credibility beat with professionals at work and a services checklist overlay in brand accent color. Closes on a static brand card with location tag, phone number, and soft CTA button. Arc shape: aspiration → credibility → access
author: Official
